# Architecture and module boundaries

- **Repository control**. REPO_CONTRACT.md governs identity and authority. AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md constrain changes; the document register locates controlled and informative documents. Governance changes require an explicit contract update. ([`REPO_CONTRACT.md:62`](../../../REPO_CONTRACT.md#L62), [`AGENTS.md:32`](../../../AGENTS.md#L32), [`CONTRIBUTING.md:27`](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md#L27), [`docs/00_control/003_document_register.md:16`](../../00_control/003_document_register.md#L16))
- **Current source-to-codebook tooling**. The CSV is the input boundary. scripts/generate_codebook.py owns loading, basic required-field and ID checks, rendering, and drift detection. CODEBOOK.md is the output; generator changes must preserve the source authority. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:14`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L14), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:15`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L15), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:44`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L44), [`CODEBOOK.md:19`](../../../CODEBOOK.md#L19))
- **Product documentation**. docs/10_product owns intended users, use cases, scope, and source limitations. It describes product intent; definitions remain proposals requiring empirical testing. ([`docs/10_product/101_product_overview.md:48`](../../10_product/101_product_overview.md#L48), [`docs/10_product/103_scope_and_limitations.md:36`](../../10_product/103_scope_and_limitations.md#L36))
- **Requirements and proposed design**. docs/20_requirements defines proposed data obligations. docs/30_design proposes entities, annotation handoffs, and boundary decisions; it does not supply an implemented schema or validator. ([`docs/20_requirements/201_data_requirements.md:19`](../../20_requirements/201_data_requirements.md#L19), [`docs/30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md:19`](../../30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md#L19), [`docs/30_design/302_annotation_workflow.md:20`](../../30_design/302_annotation_workflow.md#L20), [`docs/30_design/303_boundary_matrices.md:19`](../../30_design/303_boundary_matrices.md#L19))
- **Delivery and verification plans**. docs/40_delivery orders normalisation, annotation-contract implementation, pilot materials, independent coding, and revision. PILOT.md specifies the proposed study; docs/50_verification specifies future conformance checks, separate from taxonomy validation. ([`docs/40_delivery/401_implementation_plan.md:55`](../../40_delivery/401_implementation_plan.md#L55), [`PILOT.md:72`](../../../PILOT.md#L72), [`docs/50_verification/501_schema_validation_plan.md:86`](../../50_verification/501_schema_validation_plan.md#L86))
- **Reference material**. docs/80_reference provides glossary, design provenance, candidate tooling, and this atlas. The DeepSeek conversation is an informative proposal subordinate to the contract and original CSV. ([`docs/00_control/003_document_register.md:34`](../../00_control/003_document_register.md#L34), [`docs/80_reference/802_design_proposal_provenance.md:41`](../802_design_proposal_provenance.md#L41), [`docs/00_control/003_document_register.md:37`](../../00_control/003_document_register.md#L37))
- **Data and privacy boundary**. Future corpora and private annotation records belong outside public version control. .gitignore excludes local raw/private data, local reports, databases, environments, and credentials; the original CSV and checksum must remain recoverable during normalisation. ([`CONTRIBUTING.md:87`](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md#L87), [`.gitignore:9`](../../../.gitignore#L9), [`docs/20_requirements/201_data_requirements.md:21`](../../20_requirements/201_data_requirements.md#L21))
